You're investigating a git branch in the repo at /Users/marcel.a.n.navarro/Dev/Zimmermann-Handover (a design-to-code handover repo for a client called Zimmermann; component tag prefix is `zimm-`). The current working directory is already checked out on branch `feature/browser-preview-and-full-kit-catalog`; `main` also exists locally and is up to date with origin. This is a READ-ONLY investigation: do not edit files, do not switch/checkout branches, do not commit.

Background: this branch's headline change is migrating the entire component library (02-design/library/elements/) off native Web Components (Shadow DOM + customElements.define) onto a custom render-function registry pattern, because the library's real purpose is to hand off markup/CSS for a later React port and Shadow DOM was the wrong fit for that. The new pattern: window.ZIMM_RENDERERS['zimm-name'] = function(el, slots) { return htmlString }, driven by a shared 02-design/library/runtime.js that walks the page once on load.

Two commits describe this (verify the actual code matches these claims, don't just trust the prose):

COMMIT 2f0f59a: "Split token CSS by category, migrate component library off Shadow DOM" — introduces runtime.js and the ZIMM_RENDERERS pattern, ports it from a reference project, adds captureSlots() to hand-roll slot preservation since ~half the library depends on native <slot> which has no equivalent outside Shadow DOM. Says this trades away live reactivity (acceptable since demo.html markup is static). Only zimm-button converted in this commit as the reference implementation. States 4 components (input-action, footer, product-detail-options, product-detail) are KNOWN BROKEN after this commit because they assumed the old Shadow-DOM button existed as a nested custom element inside their own shadow templates — tracked as next step, not fixed here.

COMMIT d53dc39: "Convert remaining 26 components to the render-function pattern" — converts everything else in dependency order (atoms, then molecules, then organisms navigation/footer/product-detail last), claims zero Shadow DOM usage remains anywhere in elements/, claims this fixes the 4 previously-broken components, fixes two systemic gaps (demo.html files not linking composed sub-components' own CSS; mega-menu/demo.html loading component scripts before runtime.js), and restores mega-menu's mobile stacked-layout CSS by adding a `mobile` attribute to its contract entry and porting old `:host([mobile])` rules to a new `.zimm-mega-menu[mobile]` selector.

YOUR JOB — verify each claim against the actual current code (state of branch HEAD, i.e. the working tree right now since it's checked out) and against `git diff main..HEAD` where useful for before/after comparison. Specifically:

1. Read 02-design/library/runtime.js in full and explain concretely how it works: how it discovers which elements need rendering, how the ZIMM_RENDERERS registry is invoked, how captureSlots() preserves slotted content without native <slot>, what the load-order requirement is (i.e. why runtime.js must load after component scripts or before — check and state which), and what the `data-ds-control` attribute is used for.
2. Run greps across 02-design/library/elements/ to confirm ZERO remaining occurrences of: `customElements.define`, `attachShadow`, `extends HTMLElement`, native `<slot` tags in template strings. Show me the actual grep commands and their output (should be empty/no matches if the claim holds).
3. Read the full .js + .css + demo.html for these 4 components and confirm each is a proper render-function (window.ZIMM_RENDERERS[...] = function(el, slots) {...}), has externalized CSS properly linked in demo.html, and — for input-action, footer, product-detail-options, product-detail specifically — confirm they now correctly render zimm-button's markup rather than assuming a nested custom element (i.e. the "known broken" bug from 2f0f59a is actually fixed in the current state): zimm-button, zimm-input-action, zimm-footer, zimm-product-detail.
4. Confirm mega-menu's `mobile` attribute now appears in 02-design/library/contract/zimm-contract.js, and confirm the CSS selector is `.zimm-mega-menu[mobile]` (not `:host([mobile])`) in zimm-mega-menu.css.
5. Diff `git diff main..HEAD -- 02-design/library/elements/button/zimm-button.js` and confirm two specific claimed fixes are real: (a) an :active state bug that previously ignored variant/inverse entirely is now fixed, (b) the "large" size now gets an explicit CSS class instead of being silently absorbed into the base rule (compare with zimm-button.css too).

Report back with one line per claim: CONFIRMED / PARTIALLY CONFIRMED / DISCREPANCY, each with a concrete file:line or grep-output citation as evidence — no unverified restating of the commit message. End with a short bullet list of anything surprising, inconsistent, or undocumented you noticed while reading this code that isn't mentioned in the commits above. Keep the report under 600 words; lead with the verdicts, not narration of your process.

Author: TimLavelle <tim+1@lavelle.bio>

    Completes the Shadow DOM to render-function registry migration started
    in 2f0f59a (Button only). Every component in the library now uses
    window.ZIMM_RENDERERS + external CSS instead of customElements.define/
    attachShadow; zero Shadow DOM usage remains anywhere in elements/.
    
    Converted in dependency order -- atoms with no composition first, then
    molecules composing them, then the three organisms (navigation, footer,
    product-detail) last -- so each composing component could be checked
    against its already-converted children. All 27 components pass
    validate.mjs with 0 atomic-model violations.
    
    This also fixes the four components that were actively broken (rendered
    nothing) since Button's conversion: input-action, footer,
    product-detail-options, and product-detail all assumed the old
    Shadow-DOM button existed as a nested custom element inside their own
    shadow templates, which stopped being true once button became a plain
    render function.
    
    Fixed two systemic gaps surfaced during conversion:
    - demo.html files never linked composed sub-components' own CSS, only
      their JS, so nested components rendered unstyled in every composing
      demo. Added the missing <link> tags across all 10 affected demos and
      corrected authoring.md's documented head order so future /extract
      runs get this right.

    select's contract entries that don't match either the old or new

content.text: Let me also read the three remaining CSS files for full completeness on claim 3 (I've covered the .js and demo.html for all 5, but not all .css yet).

## Verdicts

**1. runtime.js mechanics — CONFIRMED.** Discovery/invocation: `run()` (runtime.js:86-88) calls `descend(document.body)`, which recurses over children and calls `renderEl()` on any tag matching `isZimm()` — tag name starts `zimm-` **and** has a registered renderer (runtime.js:57-59). `renderEl()` (lines 61-78) captures slots, calls `window.ZIMM_RENDERERS[tag](el, slots)`, assigns the result to `el.innerHTML`, then calls `descend(el)` again so nested `<zimm-*>` tags in the freshly-inserted markup also render. `captureSlots()` (lines 35-49) moves all children into a detached `<div>`, buckets only *direct* children carrying `slot="..."` by `outerHTML` into named buckets, leaves the remainder as `slots.default`; a `[slot]` on a grandchild is deliberately untouched (belongs to an inner composed component). **Load order:** runtime.js must load first — not because of the `ZIMM_RENDERERS` object itself (every component file defensively re-declares `window.ZIMM_RENDERERS = window.ZIMM_RENDERERS || {}` too, e.g. zimm-button.js:2), but because `window.ZIMM.esc/attr/bool` (runtime.js:20-30) exists only here, and attribute-reading components destructure it synchronously at the top of their IIFE (zimm-button.js:3-5). If runtime.js hadn't run yet, that throws and the component script aborts before registering. Every demo.html checked (button, input-action, footer, mega-menu) loads `runtime.js` before any component script. `data-ds-control` marks, inside a renderer's output, which node receives wrapper pass-through attributes (id, onclick, value, aria-*, etc., runtime.js:55); it's stripped after use (lines 67-72).

**2. Zero Shadow DOM remnants — PARTIALLY CONFIRMED.** `grep -rn "customElements\.define" / "attachShadow" / "extends HTMLElement" 02-design/library/elements/` → all exit 1, zero matches. `grep -rn "<slot" 02-design/library/elements/` → 2 matches, both prose comments, not live tags: `navigation/zimm-navigation.css:274` ("There is no <slot> any more") and `navigation/zimm-navigation.js:38` ("no native <slot> any more"). The architectural claim holds; the literal "should be empty" expectation does not.

**3. Four known-broken components fixed — CONFIRMED** (checked button, input-action, footer, product-detail-options, product-detail — all 5). Each registers `window.ZIMM_RENDERERS['zimm-x'] = function(el, slots){...}`. None inlines button's rendered HTML; each emits a nested `<zimm-button>` (or `<zimm-text-input>` wrapping one) tag, relying on the runtime's recursive `descend()` to render it once its script is loaded — e.g. zimm-input-action.js:35-40, zimm-footer.js:17, zimm-product-detail-options.js:47. Demos transitively load `zimm-button.js` even when not directly referenced (footer/demo.html:19, product-detail/demo.html:19), runtime.js always first. Undocumented nuance: button/demo.html has **no** CSS `<link>` for button at all — a later commit (6ece7d6, not one of the two reviewed) moved `zimm-button.css` into `02-design/library/tokens/buttons.css`, imported globally via `common.css:16`.

**4. mega-menu `mobile` — CONFIRMED.** Contract: `zimm-contract.js:176`, `{ name: "mobile", type: "boolean", default: false, managed: "zimm-navigation" }`. CSS: `.zimm-mega-menu[mobile]` at `zimm-mega-menu.css:133,140,145,157,168`; zero real `:host([mobile])` rules remain (one comment references it historically at line 131).

**5. button active/size fixes — CONFIRMED, but target path is stale.** `git diff main..HEAD -- .../zimm-button.js`: old code had one `button:active:not(:disabled)` block never branching on `inv` (only `!p` for border-color); current CSS has four explicit rules (`primary`/`primary.inverse`/`secondary`/`secondary.inverse` `:active`). Size: old code inlined `${lg ? ... : ...}` into a single dynamic rule; current CSS has explicit parallel `.zimm-btn-large`/`.zimm-btn-medium` classes with a comment confirming this was intentional. Caveat: `zimm-button.css` no longer exists at that path (moved to `tokens/buttons.css` by 6ece7d6); both fixes were already present when checked against 2f0f59a's committed version of the file.

## Surprises / undocumented

- HEAD is 3 commits past d53dc39 (`6ece7d6`), which materially touches files the two reviewed commits created — relocating button's CSS, correcting mega-menu/navigation/text-input/select/product-detail-gallery contract entries, and fixing 3 more prototype templates broken by the same migration class of bug.
- `product-detail-options.css` carries 4 TODO comments for undefined tokens (`--zimm-font-size-base`, `--zimm-font-lineheight-tight`, `--zimm-font-size-sm`, `--zimm-font-lineheight-relaxed`), matching d53dc39's "4 undefined CSS custom properties" follow-up note.
- The real load-order hazard is `window.ZIMM` (helpers), not `ZIMM_RENDERERS` (which every file guards independently) — neither commit message calls this out precisely.
- mega-menu's contract also documents a 2026-07-26 slot-count correction (1 documented slot → actually 6 named slots), framed as a pre-existing doc gap surfaced by the audit, not something the migration caused.
